atoms.a: Hey Peter! Wann gehst du zur Arbeit?
atoms.b: Hey Peter! When do you go to work?
atoms.sound: ssml: Hey Peter! When do you go to work? <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.a: Hallo Sarah. Ich gehe morgens um acht Uhr zur Arbeit. Und du?
atoms.b: Hello Sarah. I go to work at ((++eight_o'clock --nine_o'clock)) in the morning. And you?
atoms.sound: ssml: Hello, Sarah. I go to work at eight o'clock in the morning. And you? <break time='1500ms'/>
ssml: I go to work at noon. <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.a: Wann bist du mit der Arbeit fertig?
atoms.sound: ssml: When do you finish work? <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.a: Ich bin abends mit der Arbeit fertig. Und du?
atoms.b: I finish work in the ((++evening --morning)). And you?
atoms.sound: ssml: I finish work in the evening. And you? <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.a: Ich bin nachmittags um viertel nach vier mit der Arbeit fertig. Was machst du nach der Arbeit?
atoms.b: I finish work at ((++quarter_past_four --quarter_to_two)) in the afternoon. What do you do after work?
atoms.sound: ssml: I finish work at quarter past four in the afternoon. What do you do after work? <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.a: Ach, nichts Besonderes. Ich schaue fern und gehe nachts schlafen …
atoms.b: Oh, nothing special. I watch TV and go to sleep at ((++night --7_o'clock)) ...
atoms.sound: ssml: Oh, nothing special. I watch TV and go to sleep at night. <break time='1500ms'/>
